Definition: Tobijah, the name of three Israelites and of one Samaritan
BiblicalUsage: Tobiah = "Jehovah is good"; 1) head of a family who returned from exile with Zerubbabel but who were unable to prove their connection with Israel; 2) the Ammonite who with Sanballat opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem; 3) a Levite in the reign of Jehoshaphat; 4) a chief of the returning exiles
